issues.quote: Without an activity read or attestation, episodes past the aging cutoff move to "Possibly answered in CRM", off the badge, still counted.
issues.concern: Is the 24 hours wall clock or my hours? A customer who texts Saturday at 5 pm with us closed Sunday is 'possibly answered' before anyone opens the store Monday. Those are exactly the be-backs that go cold. And 'still counted' does not say where. If it is only in the metrics table and not in my per-owner count, the first rooftop on day one (no activity read) has a queue that empties itself every day and I never see who let them go.
issues.because: E6, E10, E13; A24 pauses the escalation clock out of hours but nothing says the aging cutoff does
issues.ask: State that the aging cutoff runs on the department's in-hours clock (same shared function as R5). Show 'Possibly answered in CRM' as its own count per owner row in the manager view (R7) and add an AC: an episode opened Saturday evening is still on the badge Monday morning. The 24-hour value itself is for the PM at Gate 3.

issues.quote: sales, an outbound call, text or email a store user logs in the CRM after `since`
issues.concern: Half my human contact is not an outbound touch. The customer texts 'calling you now' and rings the showroom, or just walks in, and my rep logs an inbound call or a showroom visit in VinSolutions. Under this rule the episode stays open, the manager gets an escalation text about a customer sitting at the desk, and the rep has to click 'Handled elsewhere', which then counts against him in the click share the weekly watch polices at 50%.
issues.because: E30 ('CRM status and human activity override the AI schedule'); E13; A10 lists what does not clear but not inbound calls or visits
issues.ask: Add to the CRM-activity clear: an inbound call answered and logged by a store user, and a showroom visit or appointment marked shown, after `since`, same actor rule. Add an AC for each (visit logged clears with clearedBy = crm_activity; an unanswered inbound call does not). If the provider cannot tell these apart, say so in section 9.

issues.quote: | A8 | Episode open | Member replies in the console | Clears, `clearedBy = reply` | R2 [E7] |

I cannot see which reps are following up, and I cannot see when one rep is answering another rep's customers off an oldest-first list, which is a commission fight waiting to happen.
